title: Season Acre Commitments across the Custom Application and Field Services Programmes
content:
Some programmes of Custom Application and Field Services are written around acres the member commits for the crop year, and each of those sets a charge per committed acre that is not worked by the end of the season.

| Programme | Acres the member commits for the crop year | Charge per committed acre not worked (USD per acre) |
|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 0 acres | 0.00 |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 300 acres | 2.50 |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 500 acres | 2.50 |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 500 acres | 3.00 |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 1500 acres | 3.50 |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 0 acres | 0.00 |

Two programmes carry a commitment of 0 acres and a shortfall charge of 0.00 USD per acre: the Per-Acre Custom Application and the Certified Anhydrous Application Plan. On the four that do carry a commitment, the committed acreage and the per-acre charge do not rise in step. The Season Commitment Application Plan and the Full-Service Agronomy Plan carry different commitments, at 300 and 500 acres, but the same charge of 2.50 USD per acre; the Full-Service Agronomy Plan and the Variable Rate Prescription Plan carry the same commitment of 500 acres but charges of 2.50 and 3.00 USD per acre respectively.
